entities.summary: Anna Bossman is a Ghanaian human rights advocate. She was formerly the director for the Integrity and Anti-Corruption Department of the African Development Bank (AfDB). In 2017, she was appointed Ghana's ambassador to France under the leadership of Nana Akuffo Addo.
